content.text: This bug was created with the addition of a new feature of import/export, and at first glance it's going to be a bit complicated to deal with.  The current behavior is that the verifier simply excludes nonRDFsource resources and files on disk with the .binary extension when it is traversing the tree of resources to check.

Now in addition we'll need to filter the rdf to remove references to binaries from the origin resource before comparing to the destination resource.  Determining which triples to filter out could be a little bit tricky.

I agree. Maybe at least we need to a way to address this issue so that users won't try the verification tool with binary excluded? It seem like that users may use a simple command like "java -jar bin/fcrepo-import-export-0.1.1-SNAPSHOT.jar -d data -m export  -r
" to export a dataset without the binary (-b) option and verify it at the very beginning, which could be disappointed with those mismatching messages.
Can we use the same approach as the exporter (doing a HEAD to check that the resource is a binary?)
, thanks. I think we could.  Just to make sure I understand, the logic is:
for each rdf resource get the graph
find all the triples with objects that begin with the repository base
do a head on each one and if it is a binary, filter that triple
I'm a little worried about doing a HEAD request for each resource, but we're already doing it on export, so I think it won't be as much of an issue in verification.
: when you have a chance, can you review this?

The verification tool  failed to verify the resource with binary excluded, even the triples have the same count. It seems like that it doesn't inline with the export tool to exclude binary references from exported and rewrite the RDF.
Verify useing the following configuration to verify:
2017-05-24 16:09:09,843 INFO     verifier     : 156 =>    Verifying original to copy... False – 18+18 triples - mismatch
2017-05-24 16:09:09,885 INFO     verifier     : 156 =>    Verifying original to copy... False – 18+17 triples - mismatch

comments.body:
This bug was created with the addition of a new feature of import/export, and at first glance it's going to be a bit complicated to deal with. The current behavior is that the verifier simply excludes nonRDFsource resources and files on disk with the .binary extension when it is traversing the tree of resources to check.

Now in addition we'll need to filter the rdf to remove references to binaries from the origin resource before comparing to the destination resource. Determining which triples to filter out could be a little bit tricky.

Joshua Allan Westgard I agree. Maybe at least we need to a way to address this issue so that users won't try the verification tool with binary excluded? It seem like that users may use a simple command like "java -jar bin/fcrepo-import-export-0.1.1-SNAPSHOT.jar -d data -m export -r http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest" to export a dataset without the binary (-b) option and verify it at the very beginning, which could be disappointed with those mismatching messages. Andrew Woods, Esmé Cowles Thoughts?

Can we use the same approach as the exporter (doing a HEAD to check that the resource is a binary?) https://github.com/fcrepo4-labs/fcrepo-import-export/blob/master/src/main/java/org/fcrepo/importexport/exporter/Exporter.java#L373-L381

Esmé Cowles, thanks. I think we could. Just to make sure I understand, the logic is:

  1. for each rdf resource get the graph
  2. find all the triples with objects that begin with the repository base
  3. do a head on each one and if it is a binary, filter that triple

Joshua Allan Westgard, Yes, that's the algorithm.

I'm a little worried about doing a HEAD request for each resource, but we're already doing it on export, so I think it won't be as much of an issue in verification.
Danny Bernstein: when you have a chance, can you review this?

The verification tool failed to verify the resource with binary excluded, even the triples have the same count. It seems like that it doesn't inline with the export tool to exclude binary references from exported and rewrite the RDF.
Export with binary excluded:
$ java -Dfcrepo.log.importexport=DEBUG -jar bin/fcrepo-import-export-0.1.1-SNAPSHOT.jar -a -d data -m export -r http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest

Verify useing the following configuration to verify:
mode: export
predicates: http://www.w3.org/ns/ldp#contains
resource: http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
source: http://localhost:8080/fcrepo/rest
dir: /Users/lsitu/Documents/Fedora_Import_Export/data
binaries: false
rdfLang: text/turtle
